# Better together: Celebrating the 2026–2027 Elastic Partner Awards


Recognizing partners around the world for driving innovation, adoption, and impact with Elastic


By


[Jason Kimrey](https://www.elastic.co/blog/author/jason-kimrey)


September 30, 2026

Partners are at the heart of Elastic’s customer success story: a hyperscaler embedding Elastic into its cloud platform, a reseller bringing Elastic to a new market, a services firm standing up a deployment, or an ISV building on Elasticsearch.


Across search, observability, and security, partners are helping customers put Elastic to work, bringing their expertise, reach, and services to move AI projects from strategy to deployment. We created the Elastic Partner Awards to recognize these contributions and the results partners are delivering for customers.


This year's awards kick off at the Elastic{ON} Partner Summit in Mumbai on September 29, followed by events in New York City on October 7 and Amsterdam on October 19. Additional winners will be announced in Singapore and Washington, DC in 2027.


## 2026 Partner Award categories


The Elastic Partner Awards celebrate outstanding contributions across the Elastic partner ecosystem. Each market will recognize partners with the “Partner of the Year” designation in several categories for their top performance in Elastic’s FY26:


-


Top Sourced Revenue Generator


-


Top Managed Partner


-


Top Build Partner


-


Top Resell Partner


-


Top Services Partner


-


Top Cloud Partner


-


Top Security Partner


-


Top Observability Partner


-


Top Search Partner

## Congratulations to our 2026 award recipients


Each partner brings unique capabilities and expertise, but they share a common goal: helping customers get more value from Elastic. Thank you for all of the work you do to make that possible.
